outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: read_back acts on the launched run's verdict. A `failed` background row is turned into the red by the new recorded_red (GATE RED line of the row's failed steps, each step's failing lines, `evidence: recorded <run>`, plus a did clause `<label> red read back from run X, not asked again`), with no gate asked again, so it reaches base_reading_for/gate_red_decision (task) and red_gate_stop (phase) as an inline red does. A `passed` row is still asked again through repeat(), and the new repeat_said reads the row that ask recorded: None on GATE VERDICT REUSED (whole repeat, existing line). Otherwise `<label> read back from run X: <repeated> repeated, not run again - measured again: <step> (N.N s)`, or `... did not repeat on this tree - <reason> - measured again: ...` only when a measured step is not named by the runner's left-out line (GATE_LEFT_OUT, mirrored from run-test-gate.left_out_line). The reason is repeat_reason over the reuseKey both rows recorded (moved / none recorded with its reuseBasis / same identity). New GATE_PASSED. outcome.descriptive: A background gate's red is now the verdict the drive acts on, with no second ask. A green read-back says which steps it repeated and which it measured again, with their seconds, instead of always saying it did not repeat.
